Watch Live: Demonstrators Gather in D.C. to Protest China's Xi Jinping Visit

Demonstrators gather in Washington, DC, to protest Chinese President Xi Jinping as he visits the United States on Thursday, September 24.
The post Watch Live: Demonstrators Gather in D.C. to Protest China’s Xi Jinping Visit appeared first on Breitbart.

Actual Article Body:
Demonstrators gather in Washington, DC, to protest Chinese President Xi Jinping as he visits the United States on Thursday, September 24.

The Chinese president arrived in the U.S. on Wednesday evening and was met by President Donald Trump at Joint Base Andrews.

Earlier Thursday, pro-communist counter-protesters attacked Tibetan activists demonstrating against the CCP leader’s presence in DC.
